description: This file defines an Android Activity 'OutsideTaskActivity' which sets a layout on creation and includes a method to start an external activity via an intent with a specific MIME type.

classes.name: OutsideTaskActivity
classes.description: An activity that displays a view and initiates external content viewing via an intent.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view layout.

methods.name: onViewContent
methods.description: Handles the view action to create an intent with a specific MIME type and start it, opening external content.
